Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment (PXD016314) specifically describes an affinity purification (AP/MS) of Flag-tagged Drosophila APC2 expressed in HEK293T cells to identify interacting partners. While the broader paper contains many differential comparisons in Drosophila embryos and SW480 cells, the MS dataset itself is a bait-capture experiment to define the composition of the destruction complex and its association with the SCF E3 ligase. No explicit control group (e.g., empty vector) is mentioned for the MS analysis, making it a descriptive interactome study rather than a differential treatment study.
